milestones.name: Strategy Lab Review Queue Foundation
trustworthy_now: A repo-backed review queue contract exists for repeatability, transport contract, runtime proof, degraded-state, cleanup/revoke, review decision, promotion blocker, and risk items.
The Cockpit artifact route now exposes review queue items with PENDING_REVIEW, DATA_MISSING, availability, priority, grouping, and provenance labels.
non_live_non_authoritative: The queue is not persisted to a database and does not create runtime dependency or execution affordance.
unresolved_risks: Human review ownership and review SLA are DATA_MISSING.

milestones.name: Experiment Session Envelope
trustworthy_now: A read-only experiment session schema and Cockpit payload abstraction bind runtime proof refs, reprobe refs, degraded-state refs, cleanup/revoke refs, review status, promotion blockers, timestamps, and worktree refs.
non_live_non_authoritative: The session is an offline artifact envelope only and does not orchestrate a sidecar or backend runtime.
unresolved_risks: Final self-referential post-commit refs remain DATA_MISSING inside the committed artifact and are reported in the final closeout instead.

milestones.name: Analyst Workflow Improvements
trustworthy_now: The Strategy Lab artifact review card now displays review queue, experiment session, export packet, promotion gate, cleanup/revoke, runtime provenance, unresolved risk, and DATA_MISSING cues.
non_live_non_authoritative: The UI remains a review surface backed by repo artifacts only; all runtime/current/execution/canonical flags stay false.
unresolved_risks: No human decision workflow or artifact store exists.

milestones.name: Offline Adapter Contract Maturation
trustworthy_now: Readonly transport documentation now records degraded, retry, timeout, runtime-unavailable, cleanup, promotion gate, future seam, and forbidden-surface semantics as documentation/status only.
non_live_non_authoritative: No live adapter, MCP transport, backend service, persistent runtime, token manager, scheduler, queue worker, websocket, or event streaming was implemented.
unresolved_risks: A future adapter seam requires a separate task card and new collision review.

milestones.name: Review Packet / Export Layer
trustworthy_now: Markdown/JSON review packets exist for experiment review, repeatability summary, risk summary, artifact provenance, and cleanup/revoke audit.
non_live_non_authoritative: Packets are repo artifacts only and are not delivered to external systems.

milestones.name: Reliability / Regression Hardening
trustworthy_now: Focused Python, Vitest, TypeScript, ESLint, JSON validation, API smoke, secret scan, forbidden-promotion grep, git diff check, and task-card diff check cover the new bounded surface.
non_live_non_authoritative: Validation does not exercise a live sidecar because current availability promotion is forbidden.
unresolved_risks: Full browser visual QA was not run; API route smoke and component tests covered the changed UI path.

milestones.name: Subagent Evidence Passes
trustworthy_now: Five audit-only scout artifacts record review queue, provenance UX, artifact consistency, validation/regression, and runtime boundary findings.
non_live_non_authoritative: Scouts were evidence passes only and did not assign ownership of contested runtime surfaces.
unresolved_risks: Any future live seam remains blocked by explicit promotion gates.
milestones.next_safest_milestone: Human review of repo-backed Strategy Lab packets

confirmed: The subsystem is coherent enough for offline analyst review using repo-backed artifacts.
PENDING_REVIEW and DATA_MISSING semantics are visible in docs, packets, tests, and the Cockpit artifact card.
No DB persistence, runtime dependency, backend orchestration, execution surface, live transport, or canonical financial truth integration was added.
inferred: The analyst workflow is operationally useful for reviewing existing Strategy Lab proof packets because the API smoke returns queue/session/packet counts and preserved false boundary flags.
promotion_gates_still_required: Separate approved task card for any adapter seam
Post-cleanup current availability proof that does not promote current_sidecar_available in this subsystem
remaining_blockers: Live, paper, broker, persistent runtime, MCP/live transport, backend orchestration, Tenn DB/Qdrant/news/memory writes, parser/runtime/model/GPU config changes, and canonical financial truth remain intentionally blocked.
next_safe_step: Run a human review of the repo-backed Strategy Lab review packets and record a bounded review decision artifact without changing runtime availability or execution flags.
